interface.signature: biGraph(n: int, e: int, arr: List[int]) -> int

preconditions.description: The number of edges e must be between 1 and 100 inclusive.
The number of vertices n must be between 2 and 100 inclusive.
The length of the array arr must be exactly 2 times the number of edges e.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= x < n for x in arr)
preconditions.description: Each element in the array arr must be a valid vertex index between 0 and n-1 inclusive.

postconditions.description: The function must return either 0 or 1.

postconditions.expression: return_value == 1 if is_biconnected(n, e, arr) else return_value == 0
postconditions.description: The function must return 1 if the graph is biconnected, otherwise it must return 0.
